about: The earlier public keys of incident.weather@web-summit.dinis (handed over, ended or not used), oldest first: moved here from data/keys.json, whose in-use keys stay there. Public halves only. Read every key with tools/lane-keystore.mjs.

keys.role: The Weather face: Storm Charles as a weather channel would show it (weather/, app/weather/), from the data room's published JSON only, started by incident.conductor@ at Dinis Cruz's word.
keys.how: Made in its own session on 11 November 2026 (pki-agent.mjs keygen --session, the copy whose sha256 is fcb28a1c...02ab). A session key: it ends with the session. The first weather session (02:08 to 09:29 UTC on 11 November); it handed over in agents/weather/HANDOVER.md and its key ended with it.
